source_abstract_normalized: We give a negative answer to Cedó's Problem 9 in Oberwolfach Report 51/2019. An explicit left brace of order 20 000 is nontrivial and simple, has metabelian multiplicative group with abelian Sylow subgroups, and is not an asymmetric product of two trivial braces. The obstruction is intrinsic: every such two-factor product has zero triple star products within each additive Sylow subbrace, whereas the constructed brace has (x*x)*x=x³≠0 in its 5-primary subbrace. The obstruction covers the full admissible symmetric-cocycle definition, not only a chosen bilinear construction family. All operations and the simplicity argument are given directly; exact verification programs and independent adversarial audits accompany the note.
